title: Image Generation Inputs V1
description: Canonical shared task.image_generation controls. Prompt-specific schemas may require a subset such as image_type=scenery.

image_type.description: Optional prompt-owned semantic image category. Prompt-specific contracts may require it. The local scenery selector recognizes scenery.

output_format.description: Canonical local visual-runtime output format. Cloud providers may expose other values through provider-specific contracts.

artifact_lifetime.description: Optional node-local artifact retention policy. short_lived expires after one hour; long_term uses the node's general generated-image retention. If omitted, the node's existing output-class policy applies.

quality.description: Portable quality hint. For the local visual runtime it maps to 4, 6, or 8 steps unless steps is supplied.

width.description: Requested generation width. The local visual runtime normalizes it to the nearest multiple of 8.

height.description: Requested generation height. The local visual runtime normalizes it to the nearest multiple of 8.

size.description: Compatibility alias for width and height. Explicit width and height take precedence.

target_width.description: Compatibility fallback for width. No separate post-generation resize stage is currently implemented.

target_height.description: Compatibility fallback for height. No separate post-generation resize stage is currently implemented.
